role: The /setblock command: places a block (id, meta, replace/destroy/keep mode, optional tile entity NBT) at coordinates.
scope_reason: Never reached: the agent and RL paths have no chat or command input (SPEC input: look, gui ops, held keys; no command source), and the native engine has no command dispatcher. world.conf does not list commands.
notes: The underlying World.setBlock path it calls is the native world core's own API (setBlock fuzz probes); only the command shell is unported.
